# Why this file exists: Tukey's packages depend on each other and need
# compatible versions (lingam 1.12.2 is pinned because lingam 1.13.0 caps
# scipy at 1.13.1; causal-learn, CausalDisco, pgmpy and the CPU build of torch
# must resolve together), so the template's requirements are not enough.
# Direct dependencies are in `requirements.in`. This file was generated with
# pip-compile, constrained to the `pip freeze` of the image that produced every
# stored result, so each version below equals that image's version.
# The template's Dockerfile installs JupyterLab separately.
#
# This file is autogenerated by pip-compile with Python 3.12
# by the following command:
#
#    pip-compile --constraint=frozen_image_pip_freeze.txt --output-file=requirements.txt --strip-extras requirements.in
#
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
